 O R D E R
1. Delay condoned.

2. Leave granted.
3. Application for substitution to bring on record the legal representatives of the deceased Respondent No.1 is allowed in both the matters.
4. Amended cause title is taken on record.

5. The common impugned order dated 8-7-2014 passed by the High Court of Punjab and Haryana at Chandigarh, whereby the Civil Writ Petition Nos.12137/1998(O&M) and 12481/1997 (O&M) filed by the respondents  herein were allowed, are under challenge before this Court.
6. Having heard the learned counsels for the appellants and for respondents at length and carefully perusing the material placed on record, it appears that the High Court had declared the acquisition proceedings in question as 13:08:50 IST Reason:
lapsed in view of Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
